source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Guardian_(Chambers_of_Xeric) "can only be harmed with pickaxes"; https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Slagilith "will reduce your damage by 67% if a pickaxe is not equipped"

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Bone_mace "it is effective against all types of rats by adding 10 damage to the player's maximum hit"; "The mace cannot be used against any other type of monster (including manual cast spells)"

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Chinchompa_(weapon) — grey, red and black, plus the Last Man Standing copies. Safe as a name rule: the only other "chinchompa" items are the Hunter-caught ones (same ids, thrown the same way) and the pet, which cannot occupy the weapon slot.

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Black_chinchompa — hits one more target than the grey and red ones (12 in PvM, not 11). Only this row carries the cap: a value group answers with the first matching row in file order, and the plain chinchompa row above would otherwise shadow it, so 11 is the fallback the caller passes.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Salamander — its own weapon category in the game's own classification, and one of the two melee families that reach an airborne target.

https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1791070064369647838 — "a 10% increase in accuracy and damage when casting spells from the standard spellbook". Type-keyed for the Twinflame staff, which has other behaviour to hang a type on; name-keyed for the two battlestaves, which do not.

The two families the araxyte minions' guaranteed max hit names (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Araxxor). Deliberately not the HEAVY ranged weight class, which also carries chinchompas: the rule names the two weapon families, and a chinchompa is neither.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Aquanite_hopper — a CROSSBOW passive, so the ballistae the family above shares a rule with are excluded here.

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tonalztics_of_ralos "When charged, the weapon will hit twice, with two independent damage rolls". Charge state is a game-state property the item id does not carry; the uncharged form is named "Tonalztics of ralos (uncharged)".

The charged AUTOCAST swap, whose Condemn special casts the plain sceptre's built-in spell. The registry has no category for it — the "(a)" suffix is its only mark, and "(a)" exactly: "(au)" is uncharged and cannot fire the special at all.

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Vampyre "Only specific silver weapons deal full damage". The diamond sickle is the 2025 Blood Moon Rises addition — "a blessed silver sickle with a diamond recessed into it" — missing from the oracle's own silver list, so no vector can confirm it; the wiki's examine text is the source. Without it the engine reports zero damage against tier-2 vampyres for a weapon that works in game.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Silver_bolts — the Ranged half of the silver rule, with the Blisterwood stake.

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Saradomin_strike — the god spells are unusable without their staff, so the spell picker must gate on it. The charged variants share the staves (Charge is a buff, not a weapon).
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Claws_of_Guthix — see saradominStrikeStaff.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Flames_of_Zamorak — see saradominStrikeStaff.

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tormented_Demon "Tormented demons usually have a fire shield that reduces damage done by non-demonbane weapons/spells and non-abyssal weapons by 20%." The four melee weapons the article's "abyssal weapons" names.

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Delrith "All damage dealt to Delrith is doubled when Silverlight is equipped" — Silverlight and its dyed variants; Darklight is a different weapon and does not count.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Burning_claws — 5% demonbane on both accuracy and damage. Name-matched because the claws carry no special type of their own.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Gadderhammer "possessing a 25% damage bonus against shades as well as a 5% chance to deal double damage."
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Araxxor — the one weapon that always max hits the araxyte minions whatever the loadout's best style.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Zogre "Brutal arrows are effective against them" — full damage needs the composite bow specifically.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ogre_bow "A stance bonus of 10 is used regardless of attack style used."; "Only the player's visible ranged level matters."
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Seeking_arrows — "a minimum hit of 3", clamped per roll rather than shifting the range.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Kurask "they can only be damaged with leaf-bladed weapons, broad ammunition, or the Magic Dart spell" — broad arrows, broad bolts and amethyst broad bolts.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Brutal_arrow — the ogre-bow ammunition Zogres take full damage from; the leading space keeps the match on the colour-prefixed names ("Mithril brutal").
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Crystal_staff_(basic) — "staff" is what disambiguates: the Gauntlet also has crystal and corrupted bows, halberds and helms, and none of them casts anything.

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Corpbane_weapons — the wiki's canonical list. The corp parameter is PER-ITEM, not "anything named spear or halberd": the Blue moon spear and Hunter's spear are excluded while the Thunder khopesh and King's barrage are included. Poisoned, degraded and (cr) variants of these bases inherit it, which is why these are prefixes. This table builds the registry's corpbane column; the engine then asks that column, so the weaponFlag of the same name is registry-first and answers for known ids without consulting these names.

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Powered_staff — the staves with a built-in cast. Anything unmatched is not a powered staff, which is the fallback the caller passes.
The projectiles a monster rolls its HEAVY ranged defence against (see Monster#rangedDefenceBonus): bolts, javelins and chinchompas.
The LIGHT projectiles: darts, knives, thrown axes, the blowpipe and the atlatl. Arrows — every bow — and anything unrecognised are STANDARD, which is the fallback.
The crystal-family bows are charged and have no arrow slot.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Atlatl_dart "Atlatl darts are ammunition used exclusively by the eclipse atlatl" — equipped in the AMMO slot, required to attack.

Everything else that fires from the AMMO slot. Anything unmatched fires nothing from it, which is the fallback.

Ranged weapons that ARE their own ammunition, so their AMMO slot is only good for a Prayer blessing. The tail of the list is the thrown weapons whose names do not say so — note "thrownaxe" is one word in game, which is why the "throwing axe" entry misses every axe.

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Holy_water — thrown vials that can damage demons and nothing else. Its damage formula is deliberately not modelled (see docs/ENGINE-GAPS.md); only the demons-only restriction is, so the optimizer can never offer it against something it cannot hurt.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Magic_Dart — the staves that can cast it; only the enhanced Slayer's staff gets the on-task formula.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Iban_Blast — castable only while wielding Iban's staff.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Slayer%27s_staff_(e) — the one staff with the enhanced Magic Dart formula.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Serpentine_helm — the weapons that envenom with it; VenomProc carries the Magic-cast gating the staff additionally needs.
